description: Phase 5 — Invoice sharing. One shared Unicode HTML invoice template with a kind:'pos' flag, rendered on web via the browser print pipeline (hidden-iframe print() -> Print / Save-as-PDF, ZERO new web deps) and on mobile via the existing expo-print path, plus WhatsApp text share, native share, print and copy. Depends on FEAT-002 (bill shape) and FEAT-004 (bill-detail views). Grounded in design §8: web/src/lib/invoice.ts uses jsPDF core (`const rupee='Rs. '`, cannot render ₹/Devanagari) and must NOT be touched for online orders; mobile/src/invoice.ts already renders HTML via expo-print with Noto Sans.
steps: web/src/lib/posInvoice.ts: create NEW file (do NOT edit the legacy jsPDF web/src/lib/invoice.ts). Contains the shared Unicode HTML template (generalised from mobile/src/invoice.ts) with a kind:'pos' flag that OMITS the Delivery row and renders Tax (when tax_total>0) + Payment method/status rows instead (finding 5); renders server-computed line_total/subtotal/tax_total/grand_total VERBATIM (no price*quantity recompute, finding 6); a hidden-iframe print() helper (@page A4 margin 0) giving both Print and Save-as-PDF with zero new deps; a billToInvoice(bill,items,settings) adapter; the §8.3 WhatsApp text-summary builder; copy helper.
mobile/src/invoice.ts: extend with a POS billToInvoice + kind:'pos' branch reusing the existing invoiceHtml/expo-print path (omit Delivery, add Tax + Payment status, render server totals verbatim).
Reads live settings.store_address (romanized) with the Devanagari string only as the blank fallback; bilingual thank-you per §8.2.

web bill-detail (AdminPosHistory.tsx detail view / a shared bill component): wire the five actions — Share on WhatsApp (lib/whatsapp.ts openWhatsApp with text summary), Download PDF (print dialog Save-as-PDF), Print (iframe print()), Native Share (navigator.share({text}) with copy fallback), Copy (navigator.clipboard.writeText).

mobile/app/admin/pos-bill/[billNo].tsx: wire WhatsApp (src/native.ts openWhatsApp), Download PDF (printToFileAsync -> expo-sharing), Print (printAsync), Native Share (Share/expo-sharing PDF file), Copy (expo-clipboard).
mobile/src/__tests__/posInvoice.test.ts: shared test asserting billToInvoice output foots to grand_total for a 0.5 kg line and shows NO Delivery row for kind:'pos'.
acceptance_criteria: The POS invoice renders ₹, Devanagari and emoji on both platforms (web via browser print, mobile via expo-print) with no new web dependency and the legacy order invoice untouched.
The POS invoice has no Delivery row and foots exactly to the server grand_total (footing test passes).
WhatsApp share, Download PDF, Print, Native Share and Copy actions are wired on both platforms (acceptance f).
`npm --prefix ...\web run build` exits 0; `npm --prefix ...\mobile run typecheck` clean; `npm --prefix ...\mobile test` passes.
verification: Run `npm --prefix ...\mobile run typecheck` (clean) and `npm --prefix ...\mobile test` (posInvoice footing/no-delivery test passes).
findings:
Phase-5 invoice sharing complete on BOTH platforms with ZERO new web deps; legacy jsPDF web/src/lib/invoice.ts (online orders) untouched. KEY FILES/SYMBOLS:

SHARED PURE CORE — the Unicode HTML template is duplicated (not shared across projects, since web and mobile are separate packages and neither test loader nor the web bundler can cross-import): mobile/src/posInvoice.ts and web/src/lib/posInvoice.ts carry IDENTICAL template/adapter/text logic. Both export: InvoiceData/InvoiceLine types; billToInvoice(bill, settings?{storeAddress,storePhone})->InvoiceData (kind:'pos', deliveryCharge:null, totals copied VERBATIM from the server bill — line amount = it.line_total, NOT rate*quantity; subtotal/tax_total/grand_total read straight off PosBill); posInvoiceHtml(data) (one @page A4 margin:0 template; kind:'pos' OMITS the Delivery row and renders Tax row (when tax_total>0) + Payment method/status + Paid rows; Noto Sans font so ₹/Devanagari/emoji render; same 4A watermark SVG tile as the order invoice); posWhatsAppText(data) (§8.3 plain-Unicode summary, bullet lines, foots to grand_total, bilingual thank-you); THANK_YOU_EN/THANK_YOU_HI; STORE_ADDRESS_DEVANAGARI (blank-fallback only — romanized settings.storeAddress preferred, then the romanized default, then Devanagari). mobile posInvoice.ts is import-safe for the Node test runner (NO expo/react-native/config imports — the two store fallbacks are inlined so expo-constants is never pulled in; only `import type` from ./pos, erased by type-stripping).

MOBILE ACTIONS — mobile/src/invoice.ts extended (NOT rewritten): re-exports billToInvoice/posInvoiceHtml/posWhatsAppText and adds posBillHtml/posBillText/downloadPosInvoice (printToFileAsync->expo-sharing, falls back to printAsync)/printPosInvoice (printAsync) reusing the existing expo-print path; the order invoiceHtml/downloadInvoice are unchanged. mobile/app/admin/pos-bill/[billNo].tsx: new <BillShareActions> card wires all five — WhatsApp (native.ts openWhatsApp with the text summary + customer mobile), PDF (downloadPosInvoice), Print (printPosInvoice), Share (react-native Share.share{message}), Copy (expo-clipboard setStringAsync); settings via useSettings() from src/queries.ts.

WEB ACTIONS — web/src/lib/posInvoice.ts also adds the BROWSER print pipeline printInvoiceHtml(html) (transient hidden <iframe> + window.print(), afterprint cleanup + 60s fallback) -> printPosBill(bill,settings) covers BOTH Print and Download-PDF (same system dialog's Save-as-PDF, zero new deps), plus copyText (navigator.clipboard with textarea/execCommand fallback) and nativeShareText (navigator.share with copy fallback -> 'shared'|'copied'|'unavailable'). web/src/pages/admin/AdminPosHistory.tsx: new <BillActions> injected into the existing BillCard `actions` slot — WhatsApp (lib/whatsapp.ts openWhatsApp), Download PDF + Print (both printPosBill), Share (nativeShareText), Copy (copyText); settings via useSettings() from lib/queries.ts.

TEST — mobile/src/__tests__/posInvoice.test.ts (7 assertions): server totals copied verbatim (0.5 kg line amount==line_total, not rate*qty); invoice foots subtotal-discount+tax==grand_total==152.50; NO Delivery row for kind:'pos'; Payment/Paid rows present; ₹/Devanagari/🙏 render and NO 'Rs. ' fallback; blank address -> romanized default (not Devanagari); WhatsApp text foots to grand_total.

VERIFICATION — mobile `npm test` 71/71 pass (64 prior + 7 new); mobile `npm run typecheck` clean; web `npm run build` exit 0 (only the pre-existing >500kB chunk-size warning; the html2canvas/jspdf chunks are the UNCHANGED legacy order-invoice lazy imports, not added here).
